description: Gets the result of a Foresight Planner plan that run_plan started but that was still running when run_plan answered. Pass the run_id run_plan gave. Free: it uses no plan run. If the plan is still running, it says so; call it again a little later.
name: get_plan_result

items.description:
One benefit program, or all employer pensions together, paid within the plan.

`start_ages` maps each claimant paid within the plan (person label) to their start
age (their earliest, for pensions). `amounts` is the household's amount from each year
a claim starts, a pension ends or a claimant's own fixed horizon ends, in order.
The source's household amount from a calendar year on, until the next event.

annual_amount.description: The household's amount that year, in today's dollars (mean across paths). It holds until the next event, except that an unindexed pension falls in today's dollars each year and a benefit that steps up at an age rises then.
annual_amount.title: Annual Amount

items.description:
A claim starting, a pension with an end age stopping, or a person's own fixed
horizon ending (which stops all their income), at that person's age.
items.title: ClaimEvent
AmountFrom
BenefitIncome

items.description:
Claims on a source that start after the claimant's last plan year, so none of it
is paid.

`start_years` is the calendar year each claimant would first collect, and
`last_plan_years` their last year in the plan: their own fixed horizon's, else the
plan's.
items.title: BenefitAfterPlanEnd

end_ages.description: Fixed horizon: each person's age at the end of their own horizon, by person label. Null under life expectancy.
end_ages.title: End Ages

first_retirement_year.description:
The first calendar year in which everyone in the plan is retired.

Under a life-expectancy horizon the amounts are means over the paths still running
that year, as the plan's year-by-year chart shows them.

benefits_and_pensions.description: Government benefits and employer pensions paid that year.
benefits_and_pensions.title: Benefits And Pensions

employment_income.description: Employment and other income the plan lists (the plan's Income band).
employment_income.title: Employment Income

investment_income.description: Dividends and interest earned in every account (the plan's Dividends & interest). The part earned inside sheltered accounts (RRSP, TFSA, 401(k), IRA) stays there and is counted again in reinvested.
investment_income.title: Investment Income

portfolio_withdrawals.description: Withdrawals from accounts (the plan's Portfolio withdrawals). Excludes dividends and interest, which also fund spending: see investment_income.
portfolio_withdrawals.title: Portfolio Withdrawals

reinvested.description: Income left after tax and spending, put back into the portfolio, plus the yield that stays inside sheltered accounts (the plan's Reinvested).
reinvested.title: Reinvested

spending.description: What the household spends that year (the plan's Net spendable): benefits_and_pensions + employment_income + portfolio_withdrawals + investment_income - taxes - reinvested.
spending.title: Spending

taxable_income.description: Household income the tax brackets were applied to that year: benefits, pensions, employment income, interest, dividends (Canadian eligible dividends grossed up), the taxable part of realized capital gains and RRSP/RRIF or traditional 401(k)/IRA withdrawals, less deducted contributions. TFSA and Roth withdrawals are not in it. The engine applies these after it, so they lower the tax but not this figure: in Canada the basic personal, age and pension income amounts, the dividend tax credit, provincial tax reductions and surtax, and the OAS recovery tax; in the US the standard deduction (with its age-65 addition and the 2025-2028 senior deduction) and the Social Security exclusion (Social Security counts here in full), with qualified dividends and long-term gains taxed at their own rates. Null for a run saved before this figure existed.
taxable_income.title: Taxable Income

taxes.description: Income tax that year, averaged over the paths.
taxes.title: Taxes

withdrawals_by_account.description: portfolio_withdrawals split by account type, keyed by the plan's own account types (RRSP includes its RRIF years); every account the plan holds is listed, 0 where nothing was drawn, and the parts sum to portfolio_withdrawals. Null for a run saved before this breakdown existed.
withdrawals_by_account.title: Withdrawals By Account

first_retirement_year.title: FirstRetirementYear

horizon_mode.description:
A person's horizon, and the household's: life expectancy when anyone in the plan
is on it.
horizon_mode.title: HorizonMode

anyOf.description:
How long the simulated paths ran, in years from the start: each ends when the last
person in the plan dies, or at a fixed-horizon partner's plan end if that is later.
anyOf.title: HorizonStats

horizon_stats.description: Life expectancy: the spread of simulated lifetimes. Null on a fixed horizon.

horizon_years.description: Fixed horizon: the plan's length in years (a couple's longer horizon). Null under life expectancy; see horizon_stats.
horizon_years.title: Horizon Years

household_totals.description: True for a couple: benefit and pension amounts cover both partners together.
household_totals.title: Household Totals

lifetime_taxes.description: Income tax over the whole plan: each path's total, as a mean over the paths (not a median), in today's dollars, the OAS clawback included as its own line.
lifetime_taxes.title: Taxes

median_failure_age.description: The first person's age in the median year money ran out; null when no path ran out.
median_failure_age.title: Median Failure Age

plan_end_year.description: Fixed horizon: the calendar year the plan ends, at the end of the longest horizon. Null under life expectancy.
plan_end_year.title: Plan End Year

plan_to_age.description: Fixed horizon, one person: their age at plan end. Null for a couple, whose partners plan to their own ages (see end_ages), and under life expectancy, where each path ends at its own sampled death.
plan_to_age.title: Plan To Age

plan_url.description: Link to the saved plan on the site, with the year-by-year detail: give it to the person.
plan_url.title: Plan Url

reused_run_started_at.description: Set when this answer reused an identical run of the same inputs from this assistant in the last 15 minutes: when that run started. Nothing was charged for this call, so runs_used is unchanged by it. Null for a run of its own.
reused_run_started_at.title: Reused Run Started At

runs_window.description: The period runs_used and runs_limit count over: a year on the Free plan, a calendar month on Pro.
runs_window.title: RunWindow

items.description: Portfolio value percentiles at the start of a calendar year.

ages.description: Each person's age that year, by person label; a partner whose own horizon has ended is left out.
ages.title: Ages

items.title: WealthAtAge

wealth_at_ages.description: Fixed horizon: portfolio value at retirement, each year the first person's age is a multiple of 10, and plan end. Null under life expectancy; see wealth_at_end_of_life.
wealth_at_ages.title: Wealth At Ages

anyOf.description: Portfolio value percentiles across paths, in today's dollars.
anyOf.title: WealthPercentiles

wealth_at_end_of_life.description: Life expectancy: portfolio value when each path ends (the last person's death, or a fixed-horizon partner's plan end if later). Null on a fixed horizon.

title: Get a plan result
